89797: Satou is an Ajin. He is referred to by officials such as Yuu Tosaki as Hat (帽子, Boshi). His real name is Samuel T. Owen. While Satou's father is British and his mother is Chinese, he himself is from the United States of America.
120650: Ritsu Nagai is Kei and Eriko Nagai's mother. She used to work as an emergency physician.
120651: Hirasawa is a 'man in black' who used to work for Kido.
120725: Izumi Shimomura is an Ajin. Her name is taken from her birth father's last name (Shimomura) and her mother's maiden name (Izumi). Her former name was Yoko Tainaka. Izumi is a rather quiet and reserved individual, talking mainly when informing Tosaki about something.
120726: Kei Nagai is an Ajin and the main protagonist of the series. Kei was first shown with an academic, serious personality.
120727: Kaito is Kei's childhood friend and the only human person in the entire country who makes an effort to help Kei despite the fact he is an Ajin. Kaito is shown to be a very loyal and supportive friend for reasons not yet made known.
120728: Kou Nakano is an Ajin. Nakano is very considerate of others; He was also concerned for Izumi, saying she shouldn't put herself in danger. He is also a bit clumsy compared with other characters and often doesn't know what's going on.
120852: He is an Ajin born with a weak leg. He is very knowledgable about guns and computers. (MAL)
122294: Yuu Tosaki is a high-ranked member of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. Generally, Tosaki has a commanding air about him and wears a serious expression. His answers are always short and to the point. He is also quite blunt and lacks patience.
122329: Araki is a detective from the investigation department. He assisted in the search for Kei Nagai at the beginning of the series.
122331: Kouji Tanaka is the second Ajin discovered in Japan. He is a partner to Satou. Tanaka shows a rather large resentment towards humanity after the daily torture and experiments he was subjected to during his capture.
